New Zealand v India. Coverage of the second ODI in the five-match series from Hnry Stadium, Wellington. India haven't beaten New Zealand away from home since a 4-1 series victory in early 2019. They confirmed the series win after winning the first three matches, with New Zealand picking up a consolation in the fourth game before India fought back again to win the final match by 35 runs.
